text: Never use the word 'effortless' in copy.

text: Always call it Shiftwell, never 'Shiftwell app' or 'SW'.

text: Deprioritize the Shiftwell On-Premises deployment in copy. Lead with Shiftwell Cloud.
author: Casimir Oyelaran

text: Lead with filling open shifts before timesheets and reporting.
